title: Message, Topic, and Partition Models
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Message, Topic, and Partition Models.
learning_objectives: Explain message, topic, and partition models using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for message, topic, and partition models
Assess failure and operational limits of message, topic, and partition models
concepts_covered: A topic is a named stream; partitions split a topic into ordered lanes.
Message carries topic/key/payload/offset/partition; Topic stores partition slices and offsets.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
